name: What are common challenges in meeting the 180-day 1031 exchange deadline?

mainEntity.name: What are common challenges in meeting the 180-day 1031 exchange deadline?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common challenges in meeting the 180-day 1031 exchange deadline include difficulty identifying suitable replacement properties within the 45-day window, unexpected delays in financing, issues during property inspections, or title complications. Market conditions, such as limited inventory in sought-after areas like Key Biscayne or Fisher Island, can also pose significant hurdles. It's a critical preparation step to anticipate these potential delays and have backup options to navigate them effectively, ensuring the exchange remains on track.
acceptedAnswer.description: Challenges include identifying properties, financing delays, inspection issues, or title problems, all of which can impact meeting the 180-day deadline.
